t: This Saxby CosmosEco V3 Fixed Fire-Rated LED Recessed Downlight Pack provides efficient and robust lighting for various indoor applications. Featuring dimmable integrated LEDs and a convenient 4-way, screwless push-fit terminal block, installation is quick and straightforward for professional electricians. The IP65 rating makes these chrome downlights ideal for bathrooms and other indoor environments requiring robust and efficient lighting solutions. Designed for longevity and performance, these downlights are fitted easily with a standard 57mm holesaw, ensuring a neat and seamless finish for any project.
